nom: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Clarifying Blemish Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine, minimized pores, and fewer breakouts, with several using it weekly as a T-zone treatment.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or extremely dry skin generally report the mask does not dry them out further and leaves skin soft, though a few clay-mask users expect drying and are pleasantly surprised.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oily areas (T-zone) while helping with breakouts and texture, with one noting it strips oil so moisturizer afterward is needed.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, burning, or breakouts and describe it as gentle and soothing, but one reviewer developed hives/allergic reaction and another found it simply too mild to see results.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 40s with changing skin reports positive results, though detail is limited.

concerns.aging: A single mature-skin reviewer (49) reports the product is working well for her changing skin, but detail is minimal.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including those with dry skin, report the mask does not dry out or tighten skin unpleasantly and leaves it soft; one reviewer did note her face felt a little dried out afterward.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in facial redness, including sunburn-related redness in one case and general redness/irritation calming in others; no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the mask as gentle and non-irritating even with repeated use, with one exception reporting an allergic hive reaction after a few uses.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report blemishes and spots shrinking or clearing within 1-4 days when used as a spot treatment overnight; effects are described as faster healing versus no treatment.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of acne-prone reviewers report visible improvement in breakouts, inflammation, and scarring within days to a couple of weeks; a few report slower or no visible results, and one reviewer found the product too gentle to see any difference.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the mask reduces shine and oil buildup, particularly in the T-zone, with one reviewer noting it strips oil enough to require moisturizing afterward.

aspects.libelle: Mold growth in jar over time
Uneven patchy drying if applied thick

extraits.texte: I wanted to love it but the 2nd day of using it I broke out in hives and my face was like that for around 1 week and a half :( never thought I was allergic because I've never had a reaction to anything on my face so it was a shocker. Not sure what exactly I was allergic to in the ingredients but just beware if you have sensitive skin!

I have so much excess oil in my skin that causes breakouts and acne, the first time i used it i noticed a significant different between my acne before and after! It really helped my confidence towards my skin and would recommend to anyone! i have very sensitive skin, and sometimes when i put on right after cleansing it will burn for a slight second so i reccommend waiting a bit after cleansing to use!

This mask is by far the best thing I could ever use for my acne. I have extremely dry, acne prone skin and I've tried everything on the market. It dries out the spot without drying out the rest of your skin. It can be used as a mask or a spot treatment overnight. This has taken my breakout healing time from 6-7 days to 2-4 days. For this price, you can't beat it.

I've been using this mask for a year or so now, and I can't live without it! It helps clarify my skin and slightly tighten my pores. I do see a slight difference right after I take it off, my skin is fresh, smooth and less red. I've noticed that when I don't use it as scheduled (every four days), my skin gets mad at me, it loves this stuff. I also use the powder face scrub every morning before regular cleansing. For reference, I have oily combo skin, with acne and texture. These products help temper all of that, love💕

extraits.titre: Product is too Gentle for my Skin
extraits.texte: There isn't really anything wrong with this product per se. It doesn't cause redness, dryness, or any kind of skin irritation whatsoever. However, for me, this mask is just too gentle for my skin. I noticed no difference after using this product. I would recommend this product to people with very sensitive skin, or people who have never used masks before. This is a clay mask, but it dries clear and doesn't have that "clay feel" to it as it dries if you get what I mean. I feel as if it has a lot of added ingredients that dilute and weaken the clay of the mask. The brand, TONYMOLY, isn't exactly the most clinical or scientific brand out there, and they have been known to add inferior ingredients to their products for the sake of smelling or looking more appealing. To restate, I would only recommend this product to people who have never used a facial mask before and have no idea how sensitive their skin is, or to people with sensitive skin (maybe not VERY sensitive skin though, because the brand isn't the most clinical or scientific).

I used this product last night and already it has cleared me up! have hormonal acne along my jawline and it's so hard to find something to get rid of it. I also have dry skin and it didn't dry me out. Highly recommend!

I absolutely LOVE this stuff!!!I have oily skin, acne, and rosacea. My skin feels so refreshed after using this mask. I use it about twice a week after cleansing. I totally recommend and I have put many other people on it and they love it!!!
